actualTrackingIssueTitle: AutoPerf F132 (no qualified gain): cascading-name hash cache costs versus workload
actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Disposition

**No qualified gain, not literally zero numerical improvement. No shipping change or optimization PR.** The short-name primary improved 1.97%, 2.82%, 4.49% across the only three authorized comparisons: median 2.8162% is below the predeclared 10% gate. It saved 0 B/parent tick. The intentionally long-name secondary improved 17.33%, 16.89%, 19.18%, but cannot replace the primary after timing.

The candidate grows actual CascadingParameterInfo 24->32 bytes, ComponentSubscriptionKey 16->24 and CascadingParameterState 40->48. These are struct layout costs, not a complete retained-heap measurement. The memory/workload trade-off and the long-name secondary result are preserved, not hidden.

## Actual boundary and preservation

Real public custom-attribute registration, reflected properties, HtmlRenderer activation, retained components, normal parent parameter updates and the actual generic provider create/read/dispose subscriptions. The ordinary CascadingValueSource matched control uses a different path. The probe does not inject framework callbacks as reachability proof.

54 accepted untimed lifetimes and 18 timed profile lifetimes exercise three profiles, not 72 distinct tests. Across all retained executions: 378 direct key-invariant rows, 116 selected source/PE/PDB associations and 123 actual assembly records. All 330 XML executions pass: 264 accepted original/default/candidate/restored executions plus 66 separately retained stale-owner first-restoration executions. Two equal display names represent distinct executionIds and are preserved.

All four shipping source files and all 25 original consumer files are restored byte exactly. The first incremental restore consumed the exact candidate DLL because copied source mtimes were older; the equality guard stopped it. A genuine explicit owner Rebuild and repeated tests then restored the owner. The earlier probe's six terminal-disposal assertion failures, missing-assets attempts and default snapshot/auditor corrections remain disclosed. No product disposal defect is asserted.

## Limits

Shared-box, warmed managed custom-provider rendering with four cascading properties and 64 retained children; no real Session/TempData I/O, persistence navigation, native browser, Server/WASM/Auto lifecycle, trimming/AOT, cold-start, complete compiler-input or whole-app claim. Existing refresh tests are not real live metadata-delta evidence. The two-input reconstruction is not an owner-graph rebuild.

No separate cache/public API, retained product/permanent-test change, published source branch, source PR or browser launch. The fixed classified report remains unchanged. This immutable core predates the additive publication receipt and live campaign-index update.

The immutable evidence predates the additive [verified publication receipt](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/autoperf-results/F132/publication.json). All 495 core files remain unchanged. No shipping change or source PR.
